title: EchoJEPA: A Latent Predictive Foundation Model for Echocardiography
rationale: Latent temporal pretraining is plausible dynamics, but the abstract reports only downstream representation tasks and no rollout evaluation.

title: Xray2Xray: World Model from Chest X-rays with Volumetric Context
rationale: The model learns projection-angle-conditioned radiographic transitions and evaluates generated observations and reconstruction.

title: Treatment-aware Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Longitudinal MRI Generation and Diffuse Glioma Growth Prediction
rationale: The treatment- and time-conditioned model predicts and evaluates future glioma MRI, masks, growth, and uncertainty.

title: Cosmos-H-Surgical: Learning Surgical Robot Policies from Videos via World Modeling
rationale: The surgical world model generates procedures and supports a policy evaluated on a real surgical robot.

title: Surgical Vision World Model
rationale: The study learns latent surgical actions and evaluates action-controllable future video for interactive simulation.

title: Surgical Procedural Planning as 3D World Modelling: Towards Automated Pulmonary Resection
rationale: The 3D medical world model simulates action-conditioned anatomical changes and evaluates pulmonary-resection planning clinically.
